title: Starter Timeline
subtitle: Template starter guidance
body: First 10 minutes: Open Terminal and read the first archive. Accept the starter story mission. Pin the first story marker on HoloMap. First 30 minutes: Scan a story clue with Lens. Read the Index page that summarizes the chapter. Complete the first mission step and unlock the next archive note. Review the Terminal next-step summary. First 2 hours: Add two more chapter records and connect them to missions. Use SoundCore for subtle progression notifications. Build a Terminal dashboard that reflects the creator setting.
